messages:
alice-support: Customer (acct-999) flagged their latest invoice — reserved GPU hours line is 720 but their dashboard shows ~58 reserved-hours consumed and 120 burst-hours. They think we double-charged the reservation. PDF attached: https://redwood.internal/invoices/INV-9987.pdf
ben-eng: can you paste the reserved_pool_id + reservation/commit id? also which invoice period?
alice-support: reserved_pool_id rp-6b2f, commit_id commit-37a, invoice period 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28 (but invoice generated 2026-03-05). Customer says reservation started 2026-02-01.
carla-billing: ok — need metering export around Feb window. Did they use Dedicated + burst at all? any cross-region routing?
alice-support: customer uses single dedicated pool in us-west. They had some burst fallback on 2026-02-14 during a traffic spike. Here's the small CSV extract I pulled from metering service:
```
pool_id,commit_id,window_start,window_end,hours_allocated,hours_charged,burst_hours
rp-6b2f,commit-37a,2026-02-01T00:00:00Z,2026-02-28T23:59:59Z,720,720,120
rp-6b2f,commit-37a,2026-02-01T00:00:00Z,2026-02-28T23:59:59Z,0,0,0  # duplicate row?
```
ben-eng: that second row looks suspicious. can you query metering-event-log for commit_attach events for commit-37a? we should check for duplicate attach events or replays.
alice-support: running now, pasted results:
```
2026-02-01T00:00:01Z,commit_attach,commit-37a,rp-6b2f,actor=finance-api
2026-02-01T00:00:02Z,commit_attach,commit-37a,rp-6b2f,actor=billing-worker
```
carla-billing: aha — two commit_attach events within 1s with same commit_id. meter ingestion probably didn't dedupe, produced two allocation rows.
ben-eng: likely root cause: ingestion pipeline accepted both events and the aggregator summing allocations didn't collapse on commit_id+pool+window. we had a replay bug in billing-worker last month (fixed), but looks like a regression in the consumer that started 2026-02-01.
carla-billing: action items: 1) issue provisional credit for duplicated allocated hours (calc below), 2) patch metering aggregator to dedupe by commit_id+pool_id+window, 3) re-run aggregation for affected invoices and reconcile.
alice-support: calc attempt: invoice shows 720 allocated. dashboard consumption 58, burst 120. If one attach is valid and other duplicate added 600 hours => provisional credit = 600 * gpu_hour_rate. I'll send provisional number to customer after finance ok.
carla-billing: I'll compute exact $ and approve provisional credit. hold message to customer as "we're issuing a provisional credit while we finish root-cause + reconciliation". also open an infra ticket to prevent recurrence.
ben-eng: repro steps for infra:
1) send commit_attach event for commit-XYZ to metering topic
2) immediately re-send same event (byte-identical)
3) run aggregator over window -> observe doubled allocated hours in output CSV
Suggested quick fix: treat commit_attach idempotent if (commit_id, pool_id, window_start) seen within X minutes.
alice-support: noted. I'll create the customer message and include the provisional credit ETA. tagging @carla-billing to follow up on exact credit amount.
metering-bot: Created internal ticket #MET-2219 (priority=P2) for dedupe patch and re-aggregation run.
alice-support: thanks team, will update customer this afternoon and link the provisional credit.
carla-billing: thanks — once MET-2219 has a patch PR, put me on the PR for sign-off before re-run.
ben-eng: will add unit test for duplicate-event ingestion and schedule a short rolling deploy to metering-consumer.
alice-support: closing thread for now, will post final reconciliation when MET-2219 completes. :thumbsup:
